title: Algebraic Invariants of Lightning Self-Attention
abstract: arXiv:2604.15632v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the polynomial coefficients of lightning self-attention as coordinates of an algebraic variety. In the single-token case, we characterize the coefficient variety as a rank-constrained Chow-type variety and derive algebraic equations from this description. For multiple tokens, linear relations reduce the nonlinear geometry to coefficients involving interactions between distinct tokens. We characterize the resulting variety by a common linear factor together with a low-rank condition on the remaining factors. This structure yields explicit families of determinantal, Veronese-type, and Sylvester resultant-based invariants. In the rank-one case, natural pencil and flattening equations define the variety set-theoretically. We complement these results with computations in small dimensions, where the theoretical constructions recover the generators of the defining ideals. translated_title: 闪电自注意力的代数不变量
translated_abstract: 我们将闪电自注意力的多项式系数作为代数簇的坐标进行研究。在单token情形下，我们将系数簇刻画为一个秩受限的Chow型簇，并从该描述中导出代数方程。对于多token情形，线性关系将非线性几何约化为涉及不同token之间相互作用的系数。我们通过一个公共线性因子以及其余因子的低秩条件来刻画所得的簇。这一结构给出了显式的行列式型、Veronese型以及基于Sylvester结式的不变量族。在秩一情形下，自然的束与展平方程在集合论意义上定义了该簇。我们用小维度下的计算补充了这些结果，其中理论构造成功恢复了定义理想的生成元。总体而言，本文给出了闪电自注意力的一种结构性描述……
tldr: 本文将闪电自注意力的多项式系数视为代数簇的坐标，通过秩受限Chow型簇刻画、公共线性因子与低秩条件，给出了行列式型、Veronese型和Sylvester结式型等显式代数不变量，实现了对闪电自注意力的结构性代数描述。
en_tdlr: This paper treats the polynomial coefficients of lightning self-attention as coordinates of algebraic varieties, characterizing them via rank-constrained Chow-type varieties, common linear factors, and low-rank conditions, which yields explicit determinantal, Veronese-type, and Sylvester resultant-based algebraic invariants.
